roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: Tap a role to see its people and set its rights. The Admin holds every right.

peopleManage.label: Manage people
peopleManage.hint: Add, change and turn off people. Manage the teams too. Only the Admin changes a role.

paymentManage.label: See and change payments
paymentManage.hint: See and change the payments of every project.

projectDelete.label: Delete projects
projectDelete.hint: Delete any project of the office.

projectEditCode.label: Change project codes
projectEditCode.hint: Correct the code of any project.

clientsManage.label: Manage clients
clientsManage.hint: Change the name and the details of each client.

templatesManageAll.label: Change any template
templatesManageAll.hint: Change or delete a template that another person made.

reportOffice.label: Office report for AI assistants
reportOffice.hint: The AI assistant (MCP) of this person can make the week, month or year report.
